title: Remaining natural comparison data after boundary containment
statement: Assume the boundary-to-cycle containments for all finite filtered complexes and the quotient transition maps satisfy their projection squares. Then the quotient isomorphisms, representative maps, and all filtered-map naturality data appearing after the containment clause in lem-sp-filtered-quotient-comparisons exist.

proof.text: Construct the quotient isomorphisms and representative maps from the quotient-image comparison, then prove the filtered-map squares by cokernel descent and cancellation.
